comments.text: Wired AMPLIFY_ENABLE_SANDBOX_COMMAND_WORKER flag in backend.ts, mirroring the enableSandboxConsoleWorker/enableSandboxTaskDispatcher pattern. Mutually exclusive with AMPLIFY_ENABLE_SANDBOX_TASK_DISPATCHER (throws if both set, since the command worker already includes its own dispatcher). File-content assertion test added to resource.test.ts. Full tsc --noEmit clean.
